FN-BK3XJQ4-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 54
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Russell Bedsole
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/19/2024
House Bill 54 as introduced would increase the obligations of the State General Fund,
beginning in Fiscal Year 2025, by $148,550 for each state death benefit payment paid to a
surviving beneficiary or dependent volunteer firefighters that die as a result of work-related
cancer, under certain conditions.
Page 1

FN-BK3XJQ4-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 54
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Representative Russell Bedsole
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/15/2024
House Bill 54 as passed the House of Representative would increase the obligations of the State
General Fund, beginning in Fiscal Year 2025, by $148,550 for each state death benefit payment
paid to a surviving beneficiary or dependent of a volunteer firefighter that dies as a result of a
work-related cancer, under certain conditions.
